Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 98.15 sits in the moderate range. SOFR is secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.478 is a weekly reading for Nov 13, not a live measure.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • Today: Claims and Philly Fed manufacturing at 8:30 AM; Advance Services and Reserve Demand Elasticity at 10:00 AM; natural gas storage at 10:30 AM; Treasury bill bids at 11:30 AM; 9-year 8-month TIPS and cash-management bill bids close at 1:00 PM; H.4.1 is at 4:30 PM ET.
  • Funding and broad conditions: SOFR 3.92% effective Nov 17; NFCI -0.478 for week ending Nov 13; MOVE 98.15 on Nov 18; 10-year Treasury 5.07% on Nov 18. These are lagged observations, not live funding measures. Next NFCI release: Nov 25 at 8:30 AM for week ending Nov 20.
  • Policy: Beige Book is scheduled Nov 25 at 2:00 PM ET. October FOMC minutes were released Nov 18 at 2:00 PM; this is elapsed and is not a remaining-today calendar item. The next FOMC meeting is Dec 8-9, with statement at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM on Dec 9.
  • Key upcoming macro dates checked: BEA Personal Income and Outlays (October PCE) Dec 2 at 8:30 AM; Employment Situation Dec 4 at 8:30 AM; CPI Dec 10 and PPI Dec 15, both at 8:30 AM. CPI and PPI are distinct releases.
  • Energy: EIA natural gas report today at 10:30 AM; petroleum status report Nov 25 at 10:30 AM and Thanksgiving-adjusted natural gas report Nov 25 at noon ET. Treasury bill and TIPS supply is today's market-structure watch.
Omissions and Watch
  • Date/event conflict check: the New York Fed November calendar lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM, while BEA's direct schedule gives Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2 at 8:30 AM; the New York Fed December calendar also places a Personal Income/PCE entry on Dec 23. The Nov 25 New York Fed row is retained with a visible conflict warning; the BEA-confirmed October PCE date is listed separately on Dec 2. The conflict does not establish whether these refer to the same release. GDP second estimate is confirmed for Nov 25 at 8:30 AM by both BEA and New York Fed.
  • BLS pages were not requested. Dates and ET times for Employment Situation, CPI and PPI were checked on the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar. Periods were not stated there, so none are inferred. The classifier self-test passed; unmatched events are visibly provisional Medium, with no overrides.
  • Selected events from checked sources, not exhaustive. Fed statistical releases are selected, including today's H.4.1 and next week's Beige Book. EIA dates use its stated weekly schedule and listed exceptions: no petroleum report today (standard Wednesday schedule); natural gas is Thursday at 10:30 AM, with a Nov 25 Thanksgiving exception at noon. The New York Fed November calendar has no listed release on Nov 26; no wider market-hours claim is made.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November/December Economic Indicators calendars and SOFR API; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; BEA; U.S. Census Bureau; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules; TreasuryDirect; U.S. Treasury; Chicago, Philadelphia and Dallas Feds; Conference Board; University of Michigan. Market snapshot quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this is not a full headline-risk review. Energy inventories and Treasury auctions are the identified near-term supply and market-structure watch items.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Wednesday's SPY close slipped 0.31%, VIX eased to 24.56 and MOVE declined to 98.15; the 10-year yield fell 3 bp to 5.07%. ES is higher overnight versus Wednesday's completed bar. Today's claims, regional activity, funding data, energy report, Treasury supply and afternoon H.4.1 favor waiting for price confirmation and monitoring rates, breadth and liquidity. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if releases or Treasury demand materially reprice yields, volatility expands, or ES fails to confirm with breadth, rates or depth. No unsupported levels or targets supplied. Refresh quotes and verify intended contract specifications before execution.
